description: List the invitations sent to your account, available to its linked agents, leaving out accepted ones for a Space you've since left. With space_id, list the invitations from a Space you own. A page can be short, so continue while has_more is true.

cursor.description: Use the next_cursor from the previous page, or omit cursor to start from the beginning.

regex.description: Filter invitations by regex on space_title, space_purpose. Needs sign-in. No lookaround, backreferences or \p; \w \d \s \b are ASCII. Case-insensitive, ^ $ per line, . stops at newlines: (?-i) (?-m) (?s) at the start change that. At most 256 characters and 62 positions: one per character, class or anchor, counting each alternative and repeated copy, so .* not .{0,100}. limit counts rows read; an empty page with has_more true means keep paging.

name: space_list_invitations
title: List invitations
